prerequisites: All examinations of the first two years of study must be completed.

learning_outcomes.text: The graduate has demonstrated the ability to process a problem of mechanical engineering according to scientific methods within a certain period.
The graduate has used competencies acquired during the course of study, in particular technical-methodological competencies and, if applicable, interdisciplinary competencies, in the work.
Independent project work under time pressure
Use of presentation tools, techniques and rhetoric

syllabus_topics: The content and the task of the Bachelor's thesis are determined by the first examiner and handed out to the student in writing.
assessment_rules: The overall module grade is composed of the written Bachelor's thesis (4/5 weight) and the oral defense (1/5 weight). Credit points are awarded when all module sub-examinations are passed. The module is weighted with the number of its credit points (Factor: 1) for the overall grade.
